candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (21 configuration_rejections, 9 configuration_value_rejected ERROR logs, status 503) with configuration_valid=false on revision cfg-016, producing a 15% error rate and a 1650ms ERROR checkout span through order->inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; the specific rejected configuration key is not identified.

report.explanation: Inventory is the only service with elevated errors (0.15) and configuration rejections; logs show configuration_value_rejected with 503, and the checkout trace errors at inventory. Gateway, order and payment are healthy, and no pool waiters or dependency timeouts appear, so bad-configuration is the bounded supported cause.
